title: Tools for Econometric Modeling and Visualization in R
text: Robust standard errors model estimated bgw_mle(): Comparing two empirical distributions using Poe et al. (2005) test:
code: library(modeltools)  model <- bgw::bgw_mle(   log_lik,    betaStart = beta,    bgw_settings = list(vcHessianMethod = "finiteDifferences") ) model <- add_scores(model, log_lik)  tidy(model, vcov = sandwich(model)) prep_for_gt(model, vcov = vcovCL(model, cluster = db$id)) library(modeltools)  set.seed(123) wtp_a <- rnorm(1000, mean = 0.5) wtp_b <- rnorm(1000, mean = 1) poe_test(wtp_a, wtp_b) #> Method:  Poe et al. (2005) test  #>  #> Means:  #> wtp_a wtp_b  #> 0.516 1.042  #>  #> H0: x = y  #> H1: x > y | x < y  #>  #> Gamma:  0.646704  #>  #> Gamma >.95 and <.05 indicates difference at the 5% level.

title: modeltools (development version)
text: add_scores() now log transforms likelihood function bgw_mle objects (new argument log_transform, default is_bgw(object)). Previously scores derivatives probabilities, made robust variance-covariance matrix wrong bgw_mle objects. x now defaults coef(object). is_bgw() uses inherits() longer fails objects multiple classes, e.g., maxLik. converged() now S3 generic methods bgw_mle maxLik. bgw_mle return code 3 (X-convergence) 6 (absolute function convergence) now treated converged. search_starting_values(): names preserved, n_best = 1 returns list one vector, n_best capped number candidates, original starting values always included candidate. Arguments renamed log_lik return prob_fn n_best (breaking). load_packages(install_missing = FALSE) warns skips missing packages instead erroring, returns loaded packages invisibly. poe_test() errors empty input missing values, uses sort-based algorithm linear memory use, print() returns object invisibly. suggest_parallel() suggests least one core. Test helpers longer call library(), broke devtools::load_all() devtools::test().

title: modeltools (development version)
text: bgw_mle objects now estfun() bread() methods sandwich package. sandwich(), meat(), bread(), estfun() vcovCL() re-exported sandwich, replacing package’s sandwich(), meat() bread() (breaking: bread(x, n) now bread(x)). bread() warns variance-covariance matrix based BHHH, case robust variance-covariance matrix equals vcov(x). logLik() returns object class logLik, AIC(), BIC() likelihood ratio tests use stats defaults. AIC() BIC() methods bgw_mle removed. tidy() returns std.error instead std.err (broom convention, breaking), calculates standard errors new vcov argument, uses normal p-values. Use tidy(x, vcov = sandwich(x)) prep_for_gt(x, vcov = sandwich(x)) robust standard errors.
